backup.production_rule: s104 (Lloyd 2026-10-31: close every remaining meter-check gap). admin_report_blocks_v1 lists, besides the unresolved photo mismatches, any unresolved reading whose vision_raw.photo_date_lines (written by verify-meter-photo, s103) is a non-empty array, with reason (mismatch | photo_date), photo_date_lines text[] and photo_archived (a photo path on file whose storage object in bucket cleaning-photos is gone); the 15 existing columns keep their order and the three new ones are at the end (drop + create, re-granted authenticated only). admin_resolve_report_block_v1 also answers such a photo-date finding (both actions), answers a missing id with the same 42501 'inspect_cleaning denied' as a refusal, and re-points the NEXT reading by (stay date, recorded_at, id) so a later reading of the same checkout day is not skipped. meter_settle_estimates_v1 counts an answered mismatch as B only when vision_resolved_by is a staff user whose role may inspect_cleaning (a cleaner who typed the admin sentence through resolve_meter_followup_v1 no longer makes B). system_tasks_sweep_v1 also closes open meter_estimate_settled tasks older than 3 days and skips a pattern-matching but impossible date silently; it returns the extra key info. get_meter_photo_followups gains checkout_date and guest_name at the end (drop + create, re-granted authenticated and service_role). Each replaced function is guarded on its live md5 (or this release's own) with errcode 55000. Live md5s read 2026-10-31 (md5 of replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')): admin_report_blocks_v1 e1093804346d7488d3c2b617ceae2205, admin_resolve_report_block_v1 f23647ef6a039daf1999faf9c33e35fd, get_meter_photo_followups 05c12c435acd72f5f1f04e6f657f0b66, meter_settle_estimates_v1 36726d52dccd5911ac473f607f4aab06, system_tasks_sweep_v1 e92e15b99917ab19cd8c9bf3c6510b44. s104 also adds the BEFORE UPDATE trigger s104_meter_vision_guard on meter_readings (security invoker, search_path empty): a direct write by the authenticated or anon role that changes any vision_* column or meter_flag is refused with 42501; definer functions and service_role are unaffected. Settle B ignores a reading with a non-empty photo_date_lines unless vision_resolved_at is set. The list shows photo_date rows only for verdict ok. Addendum Q (nothing blocks a report): admin_report_blocks_v1 also lists unresolved rows with meter_flag under_review (reason meter_order) and ends with resend_requested_at (from vision_raw.resend_requested_at); the answer accepts such rows and clears the flag (typed_is_right and correct_numbers); new admin_request_meter_resend_v1(uuid, text) (inspect_cleaning, authenticated only, probe-safe 42501) stamps vision_raw.resend_requested_at/by/note without resolving the row and posts one staff notice in public.ops_notices (type note, source system, audience staff, 7 days; the board has no per-person target, and the push trigger only fires for brownout and water, so no push); get_meter_photo_followups ends with resend_requested_at and also raises a reading that has a resend request. The vision guard trigger also fires on INSERT: a row written directly by authenticated or anon must have every vision_* column and meter_flag null (nothing legitimate inserts as authenticated; submit-cleaning uses service_role). admin_request_meter_resend_v1 also pushes to the cleaner who submitted the session (cleaning_sessions.submitted_by_user_id): net.http_post to notify-staff-inbox with the vault cron secret, kind meter_resend, lock-screen text 'New meter photo needed for the <date> stay.', only for the Cascade property and only where pg_net and the vault secret exist; a failed push never fails the request. Review round 4: the list keeps an under_review row on the card until the flag is cleared (a cleaner's resolve_meter_followup_v1 answer sets vision_resolved_at and leaves the flag); the answer is not refused as already answered for such a row; under_review rows are never neighbours (METER_UNVERIFIED_FLAGS); typed_is_right on an under_review row repairs the chain per meter (own prev/delta/per night from the verified reading before it when not negative, next verified reading re-pointed; a backwards number keeps empty usage and the answer carries a note); a resend request on an answered under_review row reopens it; get_meter_photo_followups raises any row with a resend request regardless of the lookback or a paid session. Round 5: typed_is_right on an under_review row repairs a meter only when the typed number is not below the verified reading before it and not above the verified reading after it (otherwise empty usage and a note); a resend re-ask copies the cleaner's earlier answer into vision_raw.previous_answer {note, at} before reopening the row, and admin_report_blocks_v1 ends with previous_answer text.
backup.notes: Phase expand: five functions replaced, no table, column, trigger or cron change. Old apps keep working: the admin dashboard reads the new fields as optional, Cascade Staff falls back to 'Report sent <date>' when checkout_date is absent. Order: SQL first, then the admin dashboard and Cascade Staff builds. The sweep returns an extra jsonb key (info); nothing reads its result but the cron job. Earlier tests changed for the new behaviour: s101_report_blocks.sql (unknown id is now 42501) and s102_task_sweep.sql (the answered B needs a staff resolver; the sweep result has info). DEPLOY notify-staff-inbox (waves commit ec5f505: new kind meter_resend, one cleaner's phones that hold the notices topic) BEFORE or together with the SQL; until it is deployed the push call is answered 400 bad_kind and nothing is sent (the staff notice still posts).
